logsource:

detection:
    keywords:
        - '%24%7B%28%23a%3D%40'
        - '${(#a=@'
        - '%24%7B%40java'
        - '${@java'
        - 'u0022java'
        - '%2F%24%7B%23'
        - '/${#'
        - 'new+java.'
        - 'getRuntime().exec('
        - 'getRuntime%28%29.exec%28'

falsepositives:

level: high
